plugin_desc: Perle IOLAN console-server SNMP child template for devices under PEN 1966. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared ConsoleServer SNMP IF-MIB floor. Proven private health is chassis internal temperature in degrees Celsius (adminTemperature DisplayString; the leading numeric value is parsed and empty or unparseable samples are skipped). CPU, memory, fan and chassis power-supply health are not published as stable shared objects, so they are not collected. adminPowerStatus is a per-plug power-management string and is not treated as chassis PSU health.
name: ConsoleServer

metrics.name: temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Perle IOLAN chassis internal temperature in degrees Celsius (adminTemperature under PEN 1966). The SNMP object is a DisplayString such as 42 C; the leading numeric value is parsed and empty or unparseable samples are skipped. High values may indicate cooling problems, high ambient temperature or overloaded hardware.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
